| `split(',').collect()` into Vec | Single `split_once` parse, no intermediate Vec |

| `total / count as u64` (lossy + unchecked div) | `total.checked_div(u64::try_from(count)?)?` |
| Missing `try_reserve` | `values.try_reserve(max_rows).map_err(Overflow)?` |
| Wrong return type (`String` → `Summary`) | Changed to `Result<Summary, SummaryError>` |
| Missing `render_summary` | Added function matching test contract |
